title: The Bank That Only Opens Vaults When the Owner Dies
hook: Inside a Swiss vault that can only be accessed after a billionaire's death—no next of kin, no lawyers, just a single passcode sent to a dead man's phone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Death, secrecy, and forbidden access trigger deep curiosity and morbid fascination.

title: The Heir Who Had to Kill His Own Charity to Inherit
hook: A billion-dollar trust fund that forced an heir to dismantle a homeless shelter he founded—or lose everything.
why_this_can_go_viral: Moral dilemma and emotional conflict make viewers question wealth's true cost.

title: The Algorithm That Hunts for 'Genetic Gold' in the Poor
hook: A hedge fund that scans DNA databases to find unborn children whose genes could cure a billionaire's disease—then buys their futures.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bioethics horror meets financial manipulation—highly shareable and shocking.

title: The Offshore Island Where Money Is Turned Into Diamonds
hook: A Caribbean tax haven where cash is compressed into synthetic diamonds and stored in a vault under the ocean floor.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual concept of turning cash into gems is easy to imagine and absurdly fascinating.

title: The Psychologist Who Made the Rich Feel Poor on Purpose
hook: A therapy method that forces billionaires to live below the poverty line for 30 days—and the dark side effects nobody talks about.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reverses the rich-poor dynamic—creates emotional tension and relatability.

title: The Accountant Who Laundered Gold Through a Dead Volcano
hook: A shadow accountant used an inactive volcano in Iceland to store gold bars for a fugitive billionaire—no questions, no paperwork.
why_this_can_go_viral: Geological hiding spots plus illegal wealth—feels like a heist movie.

title: The Broker Who Sold Life Insurance on Strangers—Without Their Consent
hook: A Wall Street broker took out life insurance policies on homeless people and collected millions when they died—legally.
why_this_can_go_viral: Outrage and horror fuel shares—viewers can't believe this is legal.

title: The Algorithm That Determines Your 'Worth' to the 0.01%
hook: A secret scoring system ranks ordinary people by how useful they could be to billionaires—your score determines if you get 'sponsored' or ignored.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into anxiety about being judged by invisible systems—relatable and creepy.

title: The Shell Company That Owns the World's Largest Prison
hook: A private prison in the US is actually owned by a shell company in the Cayman Islands—used to launder money for foreign oligarchs.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines incarceration, corruption, and offshore secrecy—explosive mix.

title: The Billionaire Who Bought a Dictator's Debt for Control
hook: A tech billionaire purchased a developing country's sovereign debt to force the government into a secret economic deal—essentially owning a nation.
why_this_can_go_viral: David vs. Goliath on a global scale—viewers love to hate the ultra-powerful.

title: The Lawyer Who Drafted a Contract That Bans You From Being Poor
hook: A legal document that forces heirs to maintain a net worth of $10 million—if they drop below, they lose everything. It's totally enforceable.
why_this_can_go_viral: Absurd yet true—makes people rage at the legal system's bias toward the rich.

title: The Shadow Bank That Only Lends to People With Terminal Illnesses
hook: A secret lending institution offers massive loans to the dying—knowing they'll never repay. The real profit comes from their life insurance policies.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mortality + exploitation is a gut punch—guaranteed outrage shares.

title: The Algorithm That Predicts How Much Your Silence Is Worth
hook: A data firm calculates the exact price a billionaire would pay to keep you quiet about a secret—then sells that information to the highest bidder.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone has secrets—the idea that an algorithm appraises them is terrifyingly personal.

title: The Offshore Bank That Employs Only Blind Tellers
hook: A bank in a remote tax haven hires only blind staff—so they can't identify the clients carrying in hundred-million-dollar cash deposits.
why_this_can_go_viral: Stranger than fiction—makes viewers question how far banks go for secrecy.

title: The Dynasty That Hid Its Fortune Inside a City of the Dead
hook: A European aristocratic family stored their wealth in a network of tombs beneath a cemetery—guarded by the dead, untaxed for centuries.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gothic horror meets real history—visually rich and deeply eerie.

title: The Heir Who Had to Fail a Polygraph to Inherit
hook: A billion-dollar trust fund required the heir to lie under oath during a polygraph test—if the machine caught the truth, the money was gone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Psychological games within families—high drama and intense relatability.

title: The Algorithm That Flags Children for 'Low Wealth Potential'
hook: Schools in wealthy districts use a secret algorithm to identify kids unlikely to become rich—then subtly redirect them away from resources.
why_this_can_go_viral: Class warfare meets education—parents and students will be furious and engaged.

title: The Psychologist Who Discovered That Money Can Erase Empathy
hook: A study found that after reaching $50 million, the brain literally stops processing others' pain—and the ultra-rich fund research to keep it hidden.
why_this_can_go_viral: Explains why the rich seem disconnected—scientific backing makes it shareable.

title: The Offshore Island Where Money Is Buried in a Nuclear Bunker
hook: A decommissioned Cold War bunker on a remote island now stores billions in cash and gold for anonymous owners—guarded by former military contractors.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cold War nostalgia + hidden treasure + secrecy = cinematic and compelling.
